craft_notes: Sthāyin: not-inside (the apophasis of interiority: mamāntar NOT — repeated at v131). Rows: row 2 (absent→may be). Close: may be (optative — fancies fall BY absence, no agent). Rejected: 'ego-dissolution' — killed: inner-making kept (antaḥ-kṛti as the object); 'just stop thinking' — killed: the verse says it is NOT there — no stopping implied.

lines: Inner-making not inside me — think thus:
l4.sanskrit_cite: cittādyantaḥkṛtir nāsti mamāntar bhāvayed iti | vikalpānām abhāvena vikalpair ujjhito bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What is inside me? → Denying inner-making, fancies fall away by their absence.
c1_essence: Inner-making not in me: fancies fall by absence.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder at identity unmade)
